label: Mechanical Wear
description: Gradual loss of material/function from friction or fatigue

label: Bearing Failure
description: Bearing seizure

label: Seal Leakage
description: Loss of containment through a seal or gasket

label: Corrosion
description: Material degradation from chemical/electrochemical reaction

label: Overheating
description: Operating temperature exceeding design limits

label: Electrical Short Circuit
description: Unintended low-resistance path causing excess current

label: Insulation Breakdown
description: Failure of electrical insulation under stress

label: Control System Fault
description: Faulty sensor/PLC/control loop behavior

label: Vibration / Misalignment
description: Excessive vibration from misalignment or imbalance

label: Lubrication Failure
description: Insufficient or degraded lubrication

label: Fatigue Crack
description: Crack propagation from cyclic loading

label: Cavitation
description: Vapor bubble formation/collapse damaging surfaces

label: Blockage / Fouling
description: Flow restriction from deposits or debris

label: Software / Firmware Fault
description: Logic error in embedded control software

label: Human Error - Operation
description: Incorrect operating procedure followed

label: Human Error - Maintenance
description: Incorrect maintenance procedure followed

label: Design Deficiency
description: Failure traceable to original design flaw

label: External Damage
description: Damage from external impact or environmental event

label: Calibration Drift
description: Sensor/instrument output drifting from true value

label: Power Supply Failure
description: Loss or instability of input power
